Expanding opportunities for durable solutions for people of concern, particularly those in protracted situations, including through strengthening the use of comprehensive approaches and contributing to sustainable reintegration and local settlement in third countries.
UNHCR has, for many years, been a key partner in Danish humanitarian assistance. This Humanitarian Partnership Framework Agreement affirms the close relationship between the two parties. In doing so, it provides UNHCR with improved humanitarian funding predictability and operational flexibility paired with an enhanced structured dialogue between the Parties on priorities, performance and results.
The partner’s results description and results frameworks are global, general, and highly aggregated and the MFA core contribution is thus reflected in the overall results reporting by the partner. Please refer to the hyperlink below.
https://www.unhcr.org/data.html
